# AIDE — Accelerating Insights and Development for Excellence

> Training and life-coaching practice of Imran Aslam — psychologist (cognitive & behavioural), NLP Master Practitioner and corporate trainer — based in Bhimber, Azad Kashmir, Pakistan. Sessions in Urdu, English and Arabic, online and in person.

## Start
- [Start here](https://imranaslam.pk/start.html): find the right door in sixty seconds
- [About Imran Aslam](https://imranaslam.pk/about.html)
- [1:1 Coaching](https://imranaslam.pk/coaching.html)
- [Contact / free discovery call](https://imranaslam.pk/contact.html)

## Six signature programmes
- [Prophetic Leadership Development Program (USWA)](https://imranaslam.pk/programme-pldp.html): 8 weeks, live only
- [Habit Architecture](https://imranaslam.pk/programme-habits.html): 4-week live cohort
- [Behavioural Sales Excellence](https://imranaslam.pk/programme-sales.html): corporate, proposal-based
- [Teach With Heart](https://imranaslam.pk/programme-teach.html): teacher training, proposal-based
- [Strong Homes, Steady Hearts](https://imranaslam.pk/programme-homes.html)
- [RISE: Youth Life Design](https://imranaslam.pk/programme-rise.html): ages 16-25

## Books
- [Books catalogue (Urdu)](https://imranaslam.pk/ur/books.html): 55 practical books — marriage, home, parenting, heart and mind, community, leadership. Every book includes a free workbook. Eight themed bundles and a permanent gift system (1/3/8 free books at 5/10/20 picks). The introduction and first chapter of the first four books are free to read.
- [Books (English overview)](https://imranaslam.pk/books.html)

## Self-checks
- [Assessment Centre](https://imranaslam.pk/assessments.html): 25 free self-checks including 8 AIDE signature mirrors. No labels, no diagnosis, no clinical screening. Results stay in the visitor's browser.

## Writing
- [Mani Writes — reflections by Imran Aslam](https://imranaslam.pk/writes.html)

## Facts
- Coaching at AIDE is non-clinical: it does not diagnose or treat mental illness; clinical needs are referred to qualified clinicians.
- Fees and dates are confirmed in writing on the free 15-minute discovery call before anything is charged.
- Payment is by JazzCash/Easypaisa or bank transfer; orders are approved only after the payment is seen in AIDE's account.
- Islah Network (led by Syeda Ammara Zaidi) and ADK (led by Halima Sadia) are independent initiatives; Imran Aslam serves both as advisor only.
- Urdu version: https://imranaslam.pk/ur/ · Arabic version: https://imranaslam.pk/ar/
